fixes.explanation: That's what David says. He tells the Philistine, "This day the LORD will deliver you into my hand… Then the whole world will know that there is a God in Israel." (1 Samuel 17:46). What the world will know is about God, not about David.
Jesse is right. Saul asks, "Whose son are you, young man?" David answers, "I am the son of your servant Jesse of Bethlehem…" (1 Samuel 17:58). That's the name David gives.
